description: CSV pressure-sensor measurements support a pipeline illegal-tapping experiment analysed through continuous wavelet transforms. This resource is provided by Kemahyanto Exaudi; Rossi Passarella; Rendyansyah and coauthors. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists CSV formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The experiment concerns pressure changes under controlled conditions; it does not establish field detection rates. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
